family.instructions: What kind of radio emitter is this most likely?

criteria.drone_link: drone control or video; 433 or 900 MHz, 2.4 or 5.8 GHz; 250 kHz to 20 MHz wide; LoRa, GFSK, OFDM or FM
criteria.commercial_wireless: Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, cellular; 700 MHz to 6 GHz; 1 to 90 MHz wide; QAM, QPSK or OFDM
criteria.radar: over-the-horizon or surveillance radar; mostly 3 to 40 MHz, some 1 to 4 GHz; 6 kHz to 1 MHz wide; FMCW or pulse
criteria.jamming: deliberate jammer on shortwave broadcast; 3 to 30 MHz; 7 to 10 kHz wide; AM noise or tones
criteria.interference: unintentional noise from electronics; any band; narrow; pulse or unmodulated carrier
criteria.military_comms: military station or data link; below 30 kHz or 3 to 18 MHz, some 137 to 400 MHz; 300 Hz to 30 kHz wide; FSK, PSK or MSK
criteria.amateur_radio: ham radio digital mode; 3 to 30 MHz or 50, 144 and 432 MHz; under 12.5 kHz wide; FSK, PSK or GMSK
criteria.aviation: aircraft voice or data; 118 to 137 MHz or shortwave; 3 to 25 kHz wide; AM or FSK
criteria.marine: ship safety or weather traffic; shortwave or 156 to 162 MHz; under 12 kHz wide; FSK
criteria.satellite: satellite downlink; 400 to 470 MHz, 1.5 to 2.3 GHz or 8 GHz; 4 kHz to 4 MHz wide; BPSK or PSK
criteria.navigation_time: time signal or navigation beacon; below 300 kHz or fixed shortwave; under 8 kHz wide; AM, PSK or OOK
criteria.other_civil: key fob, pager, sensor or weather balloon; 315 to 470 MHz, mostly 433 MHz; 5 to 500 kHz wide; FSK, ASK or AM
